assessments.reason: 2025 actual CAD 84500 and target CAD 100000 are explicit.
Subtracting the same-period CAD actual from target gives CAD 15500.
Exact conditional statement retains may, if and restricted grant.

f-chain.narrative: The society reports CAD 84500 against a CAD 100000 campaign target in 2025, a calculated CAD 15500 shortfall. Its delivery warning is conditional on a restricted grant renewal. Flooding explains the deadline extension. Different eligibility and a prior one-time gift limit year comparisons. Donor retention was not measured. Administration assistance is only a hypothesis; no consulting budget or demand is established.
f-chain.alternative_explanation: Venue flooding can explain the extension without a fundraising-process failure.
